subject: Daily AcreetionOS Update -- September 05, 2026
body:
**AcreetionOS Newsletter - September 05, 2026**

**Breaking News: Grml 2026.09 Released!**

The Grml team has just released their latest version, Grml 2026.09, code-named "Hä". This release includes various updates and improvements, and we're excited to see what features and bug fixes it brings to the table. As a community-driven Linux distribution, we're always interested in staying up-to-date with the latest developments in the Linux world.

**Community News**

* Our community has been busy with various projects, including the bash2bat conversion script, which has seen its initial push. We're excited to see the progress being made on this project, and we're looking forward to seeing the finished product.
* We've also seen some great work on security updates, with Debian, Fedora, and other distributions issuing patches and fixes for various vulnerabilities.

**Practical Tip:**

* Did you know that you can easily switch between different graphics modes on boot? Simply add the following line to your `/etc/grub.d/40_custom` file:
```
set gfxmode=1080p
```
This will force the system to use 1080p resolution on boot, rather than trying to use the native 4K resolution. This can help improve performance and reduce the risk of graphical glitches.

That's all for this week's newsletter. Stay tuned for more updates from the AcreetionOS community, and don't forget to join our Discord server for the latest discussions and news!
